evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: RGB-D detections update a 3D map as the mobile manipulator explores.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Rooms, objects, and semantic-spatial relations are dynamically updated and supplied to the LLM planner.
The scene graph is updated after new perceptual observations. For MoMa-LLM, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of open-vocabulary 3D map state.
Object-room and spatial relations change as exploration discovers new evidence. For MoMa-LLM, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of open-vocabulary 3D map state.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (open-vocabulary 3D map state) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
